note: Kit-autonomy gauntlet 2026-08-02. Base Elegg — MG / Supporter / Electric / Burst II, Missilis, slug `elegg` (the MG/Electric BASE unit; NOT the Water variant `elegg-boom-and-shock`, a separate ghost-pool kit). BOOM-INSTALL UNIT: her burst applies the kit-NAMED status 'BOOM Install' (a targetStatus window, 10s) that her S2a rider gates on via requiresTargetStatus. MODEL (6 load-bearing lines): BURST (burstCast = her OWN casts) — (B-a) all allies distributedDamagePct 39.74 /10s ('Distributed Damage dealt ▲39.74% for 10 sec'; boosts each ally's OWN distributed hits — for Elegg herself that is the S1b proc; observable as mult.distributed 1.3974 on an in-window proc vs 1.0 out-of-window). (B-b) enemy flatDamage 316.66 ('Deals 316.66% of final ATK as Burst Skill damage' — plain burst-skill damage, NOT distributed; burstCast resolves pre-FB so no +50% FB major, no range bonus — engine defaults). (B-c) enemy targetStatus 'BOOM Install' 10s (the status WINDOW that gates S2a; the DEF ▼35.64% magnitude rides the same line but is INERT — the engine drops enemy DEF debuffs, boss DEF≈0, sim.ts; it sits verbatim in unmodeled and is deliberately NOT encoded as damageTakenPct, which would be a ×1.3564 whole-damage over-credit — the cross-family S2b reviewer (claude-fable-5) independently flagged this trap). SKILL1 — (S1b) hitCount:100 -> enemy flatDamage 158.65 flavor 'distributed' ('Activates after landing 100 normal attack(s)... Deals 158.65% of final ATK as Distributed Damage'). UNGATED on status: the 'if the target is in BOOM Install' clause sits in the AFFECTS clause (it widens the target set to +2 surrounding enemies), NOT the activation clause — contrast S2a, which puts its gate in the activation clause ('after landing 60 normal attacks ON A TARGET IN BOOM INSTALL status'). The deliberate phrasing difference means S1b activates every 100 NA regardless of BOOM Install; the BOOM-conditional +2-surrounding spread is out-of-domain (single boss) and sits in unmodeled. The cross-family S2b reviewer caught the shared-prior misread of status-gating S1b; the discriminator is that an S1b proc fires BEFORE the first burstCast (impossible under a status gate). hitCount increments +hitsPerShot/shot (MG hitsPerShot 1 -> +1/bullet). SKILL2 — (S2a) hitCount:60 + requiresTargetStatus 'BOOM Install' -> all allies casterAtkPct 13.09 /5s ('after landing 60 normal attacks on a target in BOOM Install status... ATK ▲13.09% of the skill user's ATK for 5 sec'; the gate IS in the activation clause here, so this rider is DEAD outside the BOOM windows her own burst opens; casterAtkPct resolves to (13.09/100)×caster.staticAtk as a flat ATK add to each ally). The engine's hitCount counter accrues always and the gate is checked at the crossing frame (fire-time gate); the literal reading may be window-scoped accrual — at MG cadence both give in-window procs but different counts (⚑2). (S2b) passive -> all allies fillGauge 100 ('Activates when the stage target appears... Fills Burst Gauge by 100%. Activates once per battle' — the stage target is present from t=0 in the sim, so a once-per-battle battle-start team gauge fill; passive fires once at frame 0, pre-FB/pre-chain so the fill lands; this is the kit's biggest board lever — it advances the first Full Burst for the whole team). UNMODELED (verbatim): S1a anti-projectile ('When attacking an enemy projectile, damage dealt to that projectile ▲59.66% continuously' — OUT-OF-DOMAIN, the sim has no enemy projectiles to intercept) + its activation clause; the S1b BOOM-conditional +2-surrounding spread (single-target sim); the burst DEF ▼35.64% magnitude (inert). NO `ignored` blocks. ⚑ FLAGS: ⚑1 CADENCE TUPLE (mandatory): MG pullsPerSec / reloadFrames 171 datamine-unverified — drives the S1b/S2a hitCount crossing cadence and thus proc counts; recipe = read rounds/min + reload gap from a focus video. ⚑2 HITCOUNT GATE PHASING / ACCRUAL (low): S2a fires only when a 60-hit crossing coincides with the ~50%-uptime BOOM window (burst 20s CD, status 10s); the engine accrues the counter always with a fire-time gate vs the literal window-scoped-accrual reading — proc COUNT differs between the two, but each fired proc is the exact kit coefficient. ⚑3 S2b 'stage target appears' = battle-start (t=0) reading, once per battle; a multi-wave fight would re-fire per wave but 'once per battle' caps it — modeled as the single passive frame-0 fill. ⚑4 S1b '+2 surrounding enemy unit(s) if in BOOM Install' AoE is out-of-domain (single boss); only the primary target is modeled and the BOOM-conditional spread is inert here. TIER 2: status-gate (requiresTargetStatus on S2a), NA round-counts (hitCount 100/60), scoped team buff (distributedDamagePct), battle-start gauge fill (fillGauge), meta-defining BOOM Install status. Cross-family S2b (claude-fable-5) converged on the same 7-line load-bearing set + the fixture (sole-B2) concern and independently caught the S1b gate misread and the DEF▼→damageTakenPct trap.
